payload.title: Newsroom search finds exact words and shows results plainly
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-11-05, tested on Machines on Machines: (1) searching 'sound' does not find the video 'I discovered a sound that leaks your exact location'; semantic results come back but not the exact title hit. Treat as a bug first: an exact title word is never missing. (2) A search goes to a separate page that asks for the search again, with no options; searching goes straight to results. (3) Keyword and semantic matches look the same; keyword hits rank above semantic ones, and each result says which kind it is in words, never colour alone. (4) The results page needs a readability redesign, reviewed by Ryan with screenshots. Gherkin specs; ends with a p.apyr.us docs task. Separate from PPY-ec0d0a (media filter).
